headlines.headline: RUSSELL WESTBROOK RETIRES AFTER 18 SEASONS AS NBA'S ALL-TIME TRIPLE-DOUBLE LEADER
headlines.detail: Westbrook, 37, announced his retirement via social media, closing a career with career averages of 20.9 points, 8.0 assists and 6.9 rebounds, a 2017 MVP and nine-time All-Star.

headlines.headline: FALCONS' JAMES PEARCE JR. SUSPENDED EIGHT GAMES FOR CONDUCT POLICY VIOLATION
headlines.detail: The NFL banned the second-year edge rusher for the first eight games of 2026 following a February domestic-dispute arrest; he can return Nov. 2.

headlines.headline: OHIO STATE'S FALL CAMP RISERS EMERGE AS ALABAMA NEARS QB DECISION
headlines.detail: WR Devin McCuin and DL Will Smith Jr. have stood out through camp in Columbus, while Alabama trends toward redshirt freshman Keelon Russell at QB.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA TABBED PRESEASON NO. 1 IN WAY-TOO-EARLY TOP 25 AS FIFTH-YEAR WAVE RESHAPES FIELD
headlines.detail: Florida returns six of its top seven scorers as the fifth-year eligibility ruling continues reshuffling rosters at Arizona, North Carolina, Tennessee and Gonzaga.
